search_window.basis: From latest verified completed Gaza Source Watch heartbeat on 8 November at 14:44:19.738 PST to the last research check of this run. The newly retrieved November 9 (Gaza-local) report describes a Sunday November 8 official shelter assessment; exact release and event times were unavailable. New-to-watch disclosure, not independently established new storm incident.

findings.title: Gaza floods leave 350,000 displaced Palestinians without shelter: Health Ministry
findings.location: Gaza Strip, Palestinian territory (specific location not supplied)
findings.affected_population_system: Displaced Palestinian households and shelter access; Gaza Health Ministry director-general estimates 350,000 people sleeping outdoors after storm-related flooding.
findings.exact_supporting_passage: Gaza Health Ministry Director-General Munir al-Bursh appealed on Sunday for urgent shelter supplies, saying flooding had left 350,000 displaced Palestinians sleeping in the open.
findings.source_type: Established news agency reporting attributed official Gaza Health Ministry statement; unverified independent population count

discovery_context.newly_recovered_information: Health Ministry director-general's explicit estimate of 350,000 displaced people without shelter and sleeping outdoors; the existing record previously included 70,000 flooded tents and aggregate storm exposure but not this unsheltered figure.
discovery_context.storm_event: November 7-8 Gaza flooding; no separate new casualty event implied.
discovery_context.difference_from_prior_watch: Checked previous six watch heartbeats from 09:44 to 14:44 PST: none preserved this 350,000 unsheltered estimate. A November 8 photo agency caption estimated about 350,000 storm-affected people, which is not identical to the unsheltered claim.
discovery_context.caveats: The number is an attributed Gaza Health Ministry estimate, not a verified census. Separately reported estimate of 350,000 people affected is not proof all lack shelter. Exact statement and article publication times unavailable, so first appearance after 14:44 PST is not independently established.
discovery_context.crossing_context: The official also said thousands of tents awaited entry at crossings; no dated operational change to a crossing was independently verified. This is not a separate crossing-status finding.
discovery_context.bounded_review: WHO/OCHA official-first checks; twelve subsequent targeted searches; Anadolu story direct read; Reuters, WAFA, UN/UNICEF/WFP, APA and prior heartbeats examined for exclusions.

coverage_notes.purpose: Bounded supplementary Gaza recall only. Production pipeline is authoritative. No publication, approval, schedule, or production changes.

coverage_notes.coverage_assessment: OCHA OPT and WHO explicitly checked first, twelve additional targeted searches only, then direct publisher reads. One materially new-to-watch quantified shelter impact attributed to Ministry official; prior aggregate storm-exposure estimates do not prove it. WHO EMRO 502 and UNRWA 403 persist without new material deterioration. Alternative authoritative and established reporting remained available, therefore DEGRADED rather than FAILED.
